hyperedges.label: Expo Toolchain Workflow (CLI, Router, EAS, CNG)

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation (ios/android)
nodes.rationale: Native dirs are generated; never edit by hand, configure via app.json and config plugins.

nodes.label: Development Build (vs Expo Go)
nodes.rationale: Expo Go only bundles its own native modules; libraries with native code need a dev build.

nodes.label: EAS (Build, Submit, Update)
nodes.rationale: Cloud build/sign/submit and OTA updates without local Xcode or Android Studio.

nodes.label: Expo CLI Commands (install, start, lint, doctor)
nodes.norm_label: expo cli commands (install, start, lint, doctor)
nodes.rationale: npx expo install resolves SDK-compatible versions; use bunx instead of npx when bun.lock present.

nodes.label: Expo/React Native Mobile App
nodes.rationale: Prioritize mobile-first patterns, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.

nodes.label: Expo Router (src/app routes)
nodes.rationale: Every file in src/app is a screen, _layout.tsx defines navigators; keep non-route code outside src/app.

nodes.label: Do Not Trust Training Data - Use Versioned Expo Docs
nodes.norm_label: do not trust training data - use versioned expo docs
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release; APIs are renamed, moved, or removed, so read expo major version from package.json and fetch matching docs.
